source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ መዛግብተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ወርኢኩ፡ ከመ፡ ቦሙ፡ አሰርገወ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ወመሰረታቲሃ፡ ለምድር።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And I saw the storehouses of all the winds,[a] and I saw how with them he adorned all creation and the foundations of the earth.

footnotes.text: Or treasuries. The source describes places where the winds are kept.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ እብነ፡ ማእዘንተ፡ ምድር፡ ወርኢኩ፡ አርባዕተ፡ ነፋሳተ፡ እለ፡ ይጸውርዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወጽንዐ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And I saw the cornerstone of the earth,[a] and I saw the four winds that bear up the earth and the firmament of heaven.

footnotes.text: The printed Ge'ez has a singular stone of the corner; this revision does not silently pluralize it.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ከመ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ይረብብዋ፡ ለአዕልና፡ ሰማይ፡ ወእሙንቱ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፤ እሙንቱ፡ ውእቶሙ፡ አዕማደ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And I saw how the winds stretch out the height of heaven,[a] and they stand between heaven and earth; these are the pillars of heaven.

footnotes.text: The verb describes extending or spreading out the height of heaven. The source then identifies the winds as heavenly pillars.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ነፋሳተ፡ እለ፡ ይመይጥዋ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ወእለ፡ ያዐርቡ፡ ለክበበ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ከዋክብተ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And I saw the winds that turn heaven and cause the disk of the sun and all the stars to set.[a]

footnotes.text: The rendering follows the Ge'ez causative wording. The facing Greek differs here; this is not a harmonized composite translation.

source.text: ወ*ሐለፍኩ፡ መንገለ፡ አዜብ፡ (ወርኢኩ፡ መካነ፡) ዘይነድድ፡ መዐልተ፡ ወሌሊተ፡ ኀበ፡ ሰብዓቱ፡ አድባር፡ ዘእምእብን፡ ክቡር፡ ፫መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ወ፫መንገለ፡ አዜብ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

additional_translation_input.editorial_basis: Charles printed48note27 says Restored in accordance with G; printed49 Greek parallel contains καὶἴδοντόπον.
additional_translation_input.scope: Only identifies the source of the already printed parenthetical Geʽez phrase and I saw a place. This phrase remains inside the selected main transcription; it is not an unprinted Geʽez addition or fresh independent Greek manuscript witness.

translation.text: And I passed toward the south, and I saw a place burning day and night,[a] where there were seven mountains of precious stone, three toward the east and three toward the south.

footnotes.text: Charles encloses and I saw a place in parentheses and says in printed48 note27 that it is restored in accordance with the Greek. It is editorially restored wording in the selected edition, not independently established Ge'ez manuscript wording. The seventh mountain appears in verse8.

source.text: ወዘመንገለ፡ ጽባሕ*ሰ፡ *ዘእምእብነ፡ ሕብር፡ ወ፩ሰ፡ እምእብነ፡ ባሕርይ፡ ወ፩*ኒ፡ እምእብነ፡ ፈውስ፡ ወዘመንገለ፡ አዜብ፡ እምእብነ፡ ቀይሕ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And those toward the east were of colored stone, and one was of pearl stone and one of healing stone;[a] and those toward the south were of red stone.

footnotes.text: The Ge'ez mineral names are retained provisionally as colored, pearl, healing, and red stone. In particular, healing stone is not silently replaced with jasper from the facing Greek/editorial discussion; printed49 note13 calls the Greek stone-name wording corrupt.

source.text: ወማእከላይሰ፡ ይጐድእ፡ *እስከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ መንበረ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእምእብነ፡ ፑክ፡ ወይማሑ፡ ለመንበሩ፡ እምእብነ፡ ሰንፔር።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And the middle one reached to heaven, like the throne of the Lord, made of a stone called puk;[a] and the top of the throne was of sapphire stone.[b]

footnotes.text: Puk transliterates the uncertain printed stone name. The earlier English crystal is not established by this scan review; no precise mineral identification is claimed.
The second phrase describes the top or upper part of the throne; sapphire is retained, not moved to an invented foundation.

source.text: [ወርኢኩ፡ ህየ፡] መካነ፡ †ማዕዶተ፡† ለ*ዐቢይ፡ ምድር፡ ህየ፡ ይትጋብኡ፡ ሰማያት፡
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And there I saw[a] a place beyond the great earth;[b] there the heavens gather together.[c]

footnotes.text: Charles puts and I saw there in square brackets; printed49 note52 describes it as an addition in Ethiopic. It is retained as printed, not called an independent Greek reading or an editorial restoration.

The printed Ge'ez word rendered beyond is marked corrupt. Printed49 note54 compares a Greek beyond-form with an end-form. This translation follows the printed Ge'ez surface reading; it does not settle the underlying textual problem.

The subject heavens continues at the start of printed50/PDF88. The old verse stopped before this word, leaving an unsupported they. Printed49 note56 also questions the Ge'ez rendering against the Greek; the gathering verb is retained as printed.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ንቅዐተ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ በአዕማዲሁ፡ ለእሳተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ በውስተቶሙ፡ አዕማደ፡ እሳት፡ ዘይወርድ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኍልቈ፡ ወእመንገለ፡ መልዕልት፡ ወ*እመንገለ፡ ዕመቅ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: And I saw a deep chasm with its columns of heavenly fire, and I saw among them columns of fire descending; they had no number, from above and from below.[a]

footnotes.text: The printed clause speaks of descending columns with no number and directions above and below. This is not emended to a statement that the chasm cannot be measured in height or depth. Charles records variants in printed50 notes3-12.

source.text: ይቤ፡ መልአክ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ መካነ፡ ተፍጻሜቱ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ወለምድር፤ ቤተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ ኮኖሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ለከዋክብተ፡ ወለኃይለ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: The angel said, “This is the place of the end of heaven and earth; this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.”

source.text: ወከዋክብት፡ እለ፡ ያንኰረኵሩ፡ ዲበ፡ እሳት፡ እሉ፡ ውእቶሙ፡ እለ፡ ኃለፉ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምቅድመ፡ ጽባሖሙ፡ እስመ፡ ኢመጽኡ፡ በጊዜሆሙ።
source.note: Unapplied scan-bound candidate; Charles1906 printed48-50/PDF86-88; critical marks retained, superscript apparatus numbers suppressed. Selected edited text, not independent manuscript attestation.

translation.text: “And the stars that roll over the fire are those that transgressed the command of the Lord before their dawn,[a] because they did not come at their appointed time.”

footnotes.text: The phrase before their dawn preserves the surface Ge'ez temporal wording. A first-rising interpretation is possible but not silently substituted here.
